It leaves white-hot flames in its wake when the blade glows red.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 24 |durability = 36 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Flameblade}} Flameblades are magical swords that were forged in the lava of [[Death Mountain]]. They belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s with elemental properties.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} When they are glowing red, they emit [[Fire]] when swung. Equipping one provides [[Link]] with one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They are often used by [[Enemy|Enemies]] in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[East Necluda]]. When used against [[Ice]]-related Enemies, such as [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]] and [[Ice Keese]], they will be defeated with a single strike.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use a fiery attack against an icy enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Though their strength comes from their Fire damage, Flameblades are still made of metal. Therefore, they can attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. They also sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but do not burn if they are exposed to Fire or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_033" |Life = 36 |Power = 24 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 4000 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 1000 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 40.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 19 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 150 |BuyingPrice = 150 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Flamespear * Great Flameblade * Magic Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Magic Gear, Swords, Weapons |items= BotW }}
